rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an engineering professional in general.

example.english: My friend is an engineer who works in software design.
example.traditional: 我朋友係工程師，做開軟件設計。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai6 gung1 cing4 si1 zou6 hoi1 jyun5 gin6 cit3 gai3

rows.note: Use this for an engineering or technical specialist when the professional title or technical qualification is being emphasized rather than engineering in general.

example.english: They have an engineer's qualification and specialize in repairing air conditioners.
example.traditional: 佢有技師資格，專門維修冷氣機。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 gei6 si1 zi1 gaak3 zyun1 mun4 wai4 sau1 laang5 hei3 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a civil engineer working on buildings, roads, bridges, and other infrastructure.

example.english: This civil engineer is in charge of building this bridge.
example.traditional: 呢位土木工程師負責起呢條橋。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 tou2 muk6 gung1 cing4 si1 fu6 zaak3 hei2 ni1 tiu4 kiu4
